Same advance: Mikolov et al.'s 2013 word2vec; 'embeddings' is a descriptor of the same method.
Same advance as a Merton multiple: Harris (1954) and Firth (1957) independently formulated the one distributional hypothesis in the same decade.
Same advance: both cards denote the 2009 ImageNet database itself.
Same advance: both cards denote Bayes' theorem as published in 1763; one name is the long form of the other.
